description:
Sites:
- crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:97       #[derive(Clone, Debug)] struct ChangeEntry  ← canonical
- crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:?    #[derive(Clone, Debug)] struct ChangeEntry  ← mirrors canonical
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:68       #[derive(Clone)] struct ChangeEntry         ← DIVERGES (missing Debug)
- crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:?     #[derive(Clone)] struct ChangeEntry         ← DIVERGES (missing Debug)

The MemoryBackend extractions (epic JMAP-hwdv) cookie-cut from the canonical `jmap-mail-server::memory` per the workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical extension-server template" rule. Two of four siblings dropped the `Debug` derive on the internal `ChangeEntry` type.

Why this matters (engineering basis):
- Section 1 type-design: "Missing derives: Debug on almost everything." Internal types still benefit from `Debug` for `println!("{:?}", entry)` during debugging, panic messages that include log state, etc.
- Cookie-cutter rule: divergence from the canonical without a documented reason is a regression of the consistency intent.

Why P3 (not P2):
- `ChangeEntry` is a private type — no external API surface.
- Adding `Debug` to a struct with all-public derive-able fields is a no-op runtime change.
- One-line fix per crate.

Fix: change `#[derive(Clone)]` to `#[derive(Clone, Debug)]` in chat-server/memory.rs:68 and sharing-server/src/memory.rs (similar location).

Verification: `rg -B1 'struct ChangeEntry' crate-jmap-*-server/src/memory.rs` confirms only chat-server and sharing-server diverge; mail-server (canonical), filenode-server, and any future extension-server crate must carry `Debug` per the cookie-cutter rule.
title: P3: chat-server/sharing-server ChangeEntry missing #[derive(Debug)] — cookie-cutter drift from canonical mail-server
